answer: Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 103 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Because the nebula reference is updated at each oasis checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the saffron audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
